title: 第4章 万劫同观一局通第5章 龙御惊鸿震九渊
slug: 道骨仙锋谪世录第115章归一
content_zh:
一、叠层崩析·千面劫影
归墟古泽的天穹裂开蛛网状缝隙，每层缝隙后都映出不同的「劫界」：
-第一层·儒门分裂：沈墨卿挥剑斩向楚轩行，血溅泮水台，明心院弟子分成两派，一派举「仁」字旗，一派持「权」字幡，在大胤朝堂掀起腥风血雨；
-第二层·皇室覆亡：凌九霄的鎏金令牌化作厉鬼面具，吞噬皇帝魂魄，自己登基为「魔帝」，却在龙椅上化作枯骨，大胤龙脉断绝，九幽魔气淹没皇城；
-第三层·魔道猖獗：风九幽破茧而出，背后百蛊图腾遮天蔽日，他以活人血祭棋盘，太昊氏骸骨重组为魔偶，扬言要让「众生皆为蛊虫」；
-第四层·释家灭度：元晦的佛珠寸寸碎裂，八大明王法相堕落成魔，他手持染血的降魔杵站在伽蓝寺废墟中，佛号变成鬼泣，「沙门」子裂为两半。
四棋共鸣之兆：
沈墨卿的「仁」子裂痕中渗出黑雾，与凌九霄的「将」子黑气相融；风九幽蛹茧上的太昊图腾与萧素雪的测天丝产生共鸣，在空中织出「劫」字的千万种写法；元晦颈间的佛珠突然串成一线，直指叠层棋盘的「天元」位——那里悬浮着一枚晶莹剔透的「空白棋子」，正是始祖所言的「破劫之棋」。
二、隐世算师·天机入局
戈壁狂风骤起，吹开层层沙雾，露出一位坐于青铜马车中的老者。
车辕两侧挂着算盘形灯笼，车轮刻满天干地支，每转动一圈便有星屑飘落。
驾车的竟是两只机关鹤，喙中衔着泛黄卷轴，上书「算尽诸天，不窥本心」。
百里鸿生登场：
老者抚着雪白长髯开口，声如珠落玉盘却含金石之音：「沈太学主，萧仙子，诸位可识得此车？」马车顶盖自动翻开，露出内里层层叠叠的算盘，最中央的「天机算」完好无损，每颗算珠都映出众人在不同劫界中的倒影，「此乃太昊氏「窥天车」，可横穿叠层劫界，只是……」
诗号：
「一盘算珠定乾坤，半卷残书破迷津。
莫道人间无净土，且看劫外弈棋人。
他抬手轻拨算珠，归墟古泽的湖面顿时浮现无数光点，每个光点都是一个平行劫界：「诸君所见之劫，不过是太昊棋盘千万分支中的沧海一粟。
若想找到「天命唯一解」……」目光落在萧素雪手中的测天丝，「需以太昊氏神物为引，连通所有劫界。
三、测天之争·道心抉择

萧素雪的困境：
测天丝缠绕指尖，传来妘昭雪最后的叹息：「此丝连天道，断则魂归墟，续则万劫生。
」她望着叠层劫界中无数个「自己」，有的为护沈墨卿而死，有的黑化与魔道联手，有的剜出冰心弦自毁灵脉，最终定格在某个劫界——那里的她将测天丝递给百里鸿生，换来的却是沈墨卿的堕魔。
凌九霄的算计：
鎏金令牌黑光暴涨，竟震碎一层劫界屏障：「老头！
若本将助你拿到测天丝，你可敢算一算……如何让「王」子吞噬其他棋子？」令牌虚影化作饕餮，在劫界中横冲直撞，所过之处棋子崩解，化作他的力量。
风九幽的诡笑：
蛹茧突然裂开一道缝隙，青鳞覆盖的手掌伸出，指尖缠绕着与测天丝同源的「蚀天丝」：「太昊氏的神物？吾早就在当年的试药中……偷炼出了克星。
」蚀天丝如活物般扑向测天丝，却在接触的瞬间发出刺耳尖啸，两种丝线竟织出「因果循环」的图案。
元晦的佛谒：
沙门子佛珠突然脱离颈间，悬浮在空中组成「舍」字：「施主们执着于「唯一解」，却不知……万劫皆空，一尘不染，方是破局之道。
」降魔杵插入地面，佛光化作桥梁，连通所有劫界的「伽蓝寺」，每个劫界中的僧人都在同一时刻敲响晨钟。
四、窥天车动·劫外之劫
百里鸿生挥动衣袖，窥天车突然分裂成六十四辆小马车，驶入不同劫界。
他本尊留在中央血池，天机算指向萧素雪：「小仙子，老叟要的不是测天丝，而是……你用它织就的「劫网」。
-沈墨卿急呼：「不可！
他要借你的灵识连通所有劫界，届时你的神魂会被千万劫界撕裂！
」惊鸿照影剑自发出鞘，剑脊《诗经》竟浮现太昊氏咒文，强行斩断凌九霄的饕餮虚影。
-楚轩行冷笑：「太学主果然还是放不下儿女情长。
content_en:
1. The collapse of stacks·Thousand-faced calamity shadows
The sky in Guixu Guze cracked with spider web-like gaps, and behind each layer of gaps, a different "realm of calamity" was reflected:
-The first level: The Confucian sect was divided: Shen Moqing slashed at Chu Xuanxing with his sword, and blood spattered on the Panshui platform. The disciples of Mingxinyuan were divided into two factions. One faction held the banner with the word "Ren", and the other held the banner with the word "Quan", causing a bloody storm in the Dayin court;
-The second level: The fall of the royal family: Ling Jiuxiao's gilded token turned into a ghost mask, swallowing the emperor's soul, and he ascended the throne as the "Devil Emperor", but turned into withered bones on the dragon throne, Dayin's dragon veins were cut off, and Jiuyou's demonic energy flooded the imperial city;
-Third level: Demonic ways are rampant: Feng Jiuyou breaks out of his cocoon, with hundreds of Gu totems behind him blocking out the sky. He sacrifices human blood to the chessboard, reorganizes Taihao's bones into demon dolls, and threatens to turn "all living beings into Gu insects";
-Fourth level: The Buddhist family is annihilated: Yuan Hui's Buddha beads are shattered inch by inch, and the eight great Ming kings have turned into demons. He stands in the ruins of Jialan Temple with a blood-stained demon pestle, the Buddha's name turns into a ghost cry, and the "Sramana" is split in two.
Signs of resonance among the four chess pieces:
Black mist seeped out from the cracks in Shen Moqing's "Ren" child, blending with the black energy of Ling Jiuxiao's "General" child; the Taihao totem on Feng Jiuyou's cocoon resonated with Xiao Suxue's Tiansi silk, weaving thousands of characters of the word "Jie" in the air There are thousands of writing methods; the Buddhist beads around Yuan Hui's neck suddenly formed a line, pointing directly at the "Tian Yuan" position on the laminated chessboard - there was a crystal clear "blank chess piece" suspended there, which was the "chess piece to break the calamity" mentioned by the ancestor.
2. The hidden fortune teller·Tianji enters the game
A strong wind blew up in the Gobi Desert, blowing away layers of sand and fog, revealing an old man sitting in a bronze carriage.
Abacus-shaped lanterns were hung on both sides of the shaft, and the wheels were engraved with celestial stems and earthly branches. Stardust fell down every time it turned.
The people driving the car were actually two cranes with a yellow scroll in their beaks, which read, "Calculate all the heavens and never look into my heart."
Baili Hongsheng appears:
The old man stroked his long snow-white beard and spoke, his voice sounding like pearls falling on a jade plate but containing the sound of gold and stone: "Master Shen, Fairy Xiao, do you recognize this carriage?" The top of the carriage opened automatically, revealing the layered interior. The abacus, the "Heaven's Secret Calculation" in the center is intact, and each bead reflects the reflection of everyone in different tribulation realms. "This is the Taihao family's "sky-peeping chariot", which can traverse multiple tribulation realms, but..."
Poetry number:
"A calculation of the abacus determines the world, and a half-volume of broken books breaks the puzzle.
There is no pure land in the human world, let’s look at the chess players outside the calamity.
He raised his hand and flicked the beads, and countless light spots suddenly appeared on the lake in Guixu Ancient Ze. Each light spot was a parallel realm of calamity: "The calamity you see is just a drop in the ocean among the millions of branches of Taihao's chessboard.
If you want to find "the only solution to destiny"..." His eyes fell on the Tiansi silk in Xiao Suxue's hand, "We need to use Taihao's divine object as a guide to connect all the realms of calamity.
3. The battle for measuring the sky and the choice of Taoist heart
Xiao Suxue’s dilemma:
The heavenly silk was wrapped around the fingertips, and Yuan Zhaoxue's last sigh came out: "This silk is connected to the heavenly path. If it is broken, the soul will return to the ruins, and if it is continued, countless catastrophes will occur."
" She looked at the countless "selves" in the multilayered tribulation worlds. Some died to protect Shen Moqing, some turned black and joined forces with the devil, and some dug out the ice heartstrings and destroyed their spiritual veins. Finally, they settled in a certain tribulation world - where she handed Baili Hongsheng the measuring silk, but what she got in exchange was Shen Moqing's demonization.
Ling Jiuxiao’s plan:
The black light of the gilt token surged, shattering a layer of calamity barrier: "Old man!
If I help you get the Tencel, do you dare to do the math... How to make the "King" piece devour other pieces? ” The shadow of the token turned into Taotie, rampaging through the world of calamity. The chess pieces disintegrated wherever he passed, turning into his power.
Feng Jiuyou’s sly smile:
A gap suddenly opened in the cocoon, and the palm covered with green scales stretched out, and the fingertips were wrapped with the "Eclipse Tencel" which has the same origin as the Tiansi Silk: "The Taihao Clan's divine object? I had already secretly refined the nemesis in the test medicine back then.
"The Eclipse Tencel pounced on the Measurement Tencel like a living creature, but at the moment of contact, it let out a piercing scream, and the two kinds of silk threads actually woven together.Draw the pattern of "causal cycle".
Yuan Hui’s Visit to the Buddha:
The Buddhist beads of Shamenzi suddenly broke away from the neck and floated in the air to form the word "Sacrifice": "Donors are obsessed with the "only solution", but they don't know... The only way to break the situation is to have all calamities in vain and be spotless.
"The demon-subduing pestle is inserted into the ground, and the Buddha's light turns into a bridge, connecting the "Jialan Temple" in all tribulation realms. The monks in each tribulation realm ring the morning bell at the same time.
4. Peeping at the movement of the heavenly chariot and the calamity beyond the calamity
Baili Hongsheng waved his sleeves, and the sky-peeping carriage suddenly split into sixty-four small carriages and drove into different tribulation realms.
He himself stayed in the central blood pool, and the divination point pointed at Xiao Suxue: "Little fairy, what the old man wants is not to measure the Tensilk, but... the "tribulation net" you weave with it.
-Shen Moqing shouted urgently: "No!"
He wants to use your spiritual consciousness to connect all the tribulation realms, and then your soul will be torn apart by millions of tribulation realms!
"The Jinghong Shadow Sword unsheathed itself, and Taihao's incantation appeared on the sword's spine in the Book of Songs, forcibly cutting off Ling Jiuxiao's gluttonous shadow.
-Chu Xuanying sneered: "As expected, the Supreme Master still can't let go of the love between his children.
